author: Swank22
quote:
10/10 for polished world. 0/10 for narrative design, character design, and overall plot design. I dont know who came up with lucia and jason but fire them. Jason could be a cardboard cutout and put in the back of every cutscene and you probably wouldnt even notice. Lucia is the most toxic girlfriend/girl boss character. Jason only option to every proposed plan boils down to "yes dear." and goes along with it.  Its just not a gta title. If this game was marketed as anything else then a gta title then all this would probably be blown over. But this is GTA6. This is rockstar. And after to major megahits in GTA5 and RDR2, your held to a higher standard. Not because players put you on a pedestal, but because rockstar built that pedestal and built it well, just to leap off with no parachute in gta6. Fire the writing time, every person. And hire back the ones who left after RDR2. Then maybe gta7 will release in 20 years and ACTUALLY be interesting. 

The online mode will likely be phenomenal, as everything system and mechanics wise is greatly improved. But still, nothing really new.
